title: Community bicycle workshop
passage: The community center will host a bicycle maintenance workshop this Sunday from ten until noon. Participants will learn to check tire pressure, adjust a seat, and identify when professional repairs are needed. Bring your own bicycle if possible. Tools will be provided, so there is no need to buy any in advance. Registration is free, but space is limited to twelve participants. Please register through the center's website by Friday. Children under twelve must attend with an adult.
passageZh: 社區中心將在本星期日上午十點至中午舉辦自行車保養工作坊。參加者會學習檢查胎壓、調整座椅，以及辨識何時需要專業維修。可以的話請帶自己的自行車。現場會提供工具，不必事先購買。報名免費，但限十二位。請最晚在星期五透過中心網站報名。未滿十二歲的兒童必須由成人陪同。
